synopsis.text: The Vision visits the Avengers Mansion, but is his mission for peace or wrongdoing? Hawkeye seeks out Black Widow to convince the ex-KGB to put her villainous past behind her.

1st appearance of the Vision. The Vision attacks the Avengers. Soon he overcomes his programming and reveals to the Avengers that he was created by Ultron. Together, Vision and the Avengers go to Ultron's lair and eventually defeat him thanks to The Vision.
